newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MeesPierson to issue call warrants on Vedior.
newsitem.headline: MeesPierson to issue call warrants on Vedior.

text.p: Merchant bank MeesPierson said on Tuesday it would issue 4,000 call warrants on temporary employment firm Vedior's shares on June 5.
The strike price of the warrants, which will expire on June 7, 1999, will be 110 percent of Vedior's opening price on the Amsterdam bourse on June 5, MeesPierson said in a statement.

The premium on the warrants is 15.2 percent of Vedior's opening price of that day. The warrants are quoted in guilders and the contract size is 100. Preplacement will take place on June 4 and subscription is possible from June 2 to 4.
Vedior is currently owned by retail and business services group Vendex.
The temporary employment arm's shares will be floated on June 5.

Last week, Vendex said it had raised the price range for the Vedior shares to 37-40 guilders. It had previously announced a price range of between 33 and 37 guilders but said it had raised the band because of hefty international demand for the shares and the strong share price performance of similar companies.
